_comment: Pinned Apify actors for platform reads, per CLAUDE.md, so the Routine doesn't pick a different actor each day. `sg_platforms` is the live setup (scripts/sg_platforms.py); the two older actors below are kept for reference only.

tiktok_trends_actor.title: TikTok Trends
tiktok_trends_actor.notes: Trending-hashtags mode supports countryCode=SG directly (TikTok Creative Center rankings: rank, posts, video views, trend direction). Top-videos mode does not support SG. Cap: maxItems 20, one run per day. RETIRED 2026-10-26: the SG ranking stopped updating after 15 Oct, and its top items were non-SG creators.

instagram_trends_actor.title: Instagram Trending Scraper
instagram_trends_actor.notes: Explore feed. `country` only sets Accept-Language, it does not geolocate: on 2026-09-23 all 20 posts were US content (Hispanic Heritage Month, NFL), published_at empty on every row. Label the card as the Explore feed with SG locale, never as 'trending in SG', unless posts show real Singapore signals. ~US$0.09 and ~3 min per run of 20. RETIRED 2026-10-26: the Explore feed is not geolocated and returned almost no Singapore creators.

sg_platforms._comment: Singapore-only TikTok and Instagram videos. scripts/sg_platforms.py runs all four actors once a day (needs APIFY_TOKEN), keeps only videos from SG accounts or with local hashtags, posted inside fresh_hours (fallback_hours if fewer than two), ranked by views. {SINCE} is replaced with today minus three days. Edit the watchlist and rules here, nowhere else.

watchlist._comment: Singapore accounts, checked by hand. Accounts listed in rules.publishers also post world news, so their videos need a Singapore marker in the caption text (hashtags don't count). Everyone else on the watchlist (Stomp, sgfollowsall, creators) posts local content only and is kept as is.
